result.description:
Located in the bustling Westfield Shopping Centre north of Canberra, this leading medical practice is home to a professional team of doctors, registered nurses, and a full-time practice manager. Committed to delivering quality healthcare services, the clinic offers a wide range of services, including vaccinations, health assessments, and comprehensive skin cancer checks. 

 With one female GP having recently relocated to Melbourne, the clinic is now seeking a new General Practitioner to join their team. The incoming GP can expect 65% of billings and a busy schedule with around 30 patients per day. To ensure a smooth transition, the clinic guarantees an income of $7,000 per week for the first eight weeks, based on a 40-hour workweek. 

 The clinic operates Monday to Friday from 8:30 am to 5:30 pm, and on Saturdays from 9:00 am to 2:00 pm. Ample parking is available, making it convenient for both patients and staff. This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established practice with a strong patient base and a supportive team in a prime Canberra location. 

 This practice is currently in a DPA location for any VR doctors still within their moratorium period    Apply Now

GPs with special interests and qualifications in skin care and geriatrics will have an advantage.

We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience.

Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network.

Showcase your clinical excellence and leadership skills

Every birth is unique. Every family deserves exceptional care. And every midwife deserves the opportunity to work in a service that's investing in its people and its future.


At Monash Women's at Casey Hospital, we're expanding to meet the needs of one of Melbourne's fastest-growing communities. As our maternity service continues to grow, we're looking for experienced Registered Midwives who are ready to be part of an exciting new chapter.


About the role


Join our team as a Associate Midwife Manager with multiple part-time opportunities to work at Birth Suite - PAU based at Casey



As a key member of our team, you'll play a vital role in ensuring the smooth operation of our Birth Suite and PAU, leading clinical activities, and enhancing patient care outcomes. This role provides the opportunity to develop your leadership skills and contribute to high-quality, compassionate care for women.



Key Responsibilities:




Assist the Midwife Manager in overseeing the day-to-day operations of the department ensuring a positive and efficient environment for both staff and patients.


Support staff with escalating care as required, ensuring timely follow-up and facilitating smooth care pathways for patients.


Facilitate the care of high-risk patients by ensuring proper coordination of care and maintaining effective communication with the broader healthcare team.


Contribute to service improvements through involvement in various projects and initiatives.


Mentor and guide junior midwifery staff, offering advice and practical guidance to foster development.


Work collaboratively with other healthcare professionals to ensure holistic and patient-centered care.




The opportunity is Ongoing fulltime or part time positions available - working across a rotating roster, 7 days a week.


About Monash Women's at Casey


Located in Melbourne's rapidly growing south-east, Casey Hospital is a contemporary, purpose-built facility caring for one of Victoria's most diverse and vibrant communities.


Our maternity service includes:



Contemporary birthing suites


Antenatal and specialist clinics


Comprehensive postnatal services


A welcoming, inclusive and collaborative team



Guided by Monash Health's Care, Reimagined 2026-2031 strategy, we're delivering care beyond the hospital walls, embracing innovation and creating a workplace where our people can do their best work every day.


About you


You're an experienced Registered Midwife who is passionate about delivering safe, respectful and culturally responsive care.


You'll bring:



Current AHPRA registration as a Registered Midwife


Recent experience across maternity services


Strong clinical judgement and communication skills


A commitment to woman-centred care


Flexibility to work across a rotating roster



Most importantly, you'll bring compassion, curiosity and a genuine desire to make a difference for women, babies and families.


Why Casey?


With more than 4,000 births each year, Casey Hospital offers the perfect balance of high-acuity clinical experience and genuinely woman-centred care. Our service is entering an exciting period of growth, with services such as Midwifery Group Practice (MGP) and Homebirth as our service expands.


Whether you're passionate about clinical excellence, mentoring others or helping shape innovative models of care, you'll find the support, opportunities and team culture to thrive.


What you'll enjoy



A modern maternity service with diverse clinical experiences


Dedicated Midwifery Educators and Clinical Support staff invested in your development


Opportunities to expand your scope of practice as our service grows


A collaborative team culture where your ideas and experience are valued


Opportunities to mentor students and early career midwives


Involvement in quality improvement, research and evidence-based practice



This is more than your next role-it's an opportunity to help shape the future of maternity care.


Ready to grow with us?


If you're looking for a role where your expertise is valued, your career can flourish and every day brings the opportunity to make a meaningful difference, we'd love to hear from you.


Join Monash Women's at Casey and help shape the future of maternity care.

A well-established  mixed-billing  medical centre is seeking a  Vocational Registered (VR) General Practitioner  to provide comprehensive, continuing medical care to individuals, families, and the surrounding communities. The practice is situated in a highly desirable location, offering excellent lifestyle benefits due to its proximity to the Eastern suburbs beaches. 

 The practice environment is collaborative and highly supportive, led by an experienced and approachable Medical Director and a dedicated Practice Manager. GPs will benefit from a strong team dynamic and experienced administrative support designed to help develop their practice from day one. Qualified nursing support is readily available, assisting with all treatment room procedures, Health Assessments, and Chronic Disease Management (CDM) Care Plans. The centre supports a broad scope of practice, and practitioners are encouraged to pursue special interests, provide ongoing education, and participate in research. 

 Practitioners are afforded significant clinical autonomy and flexible working arrangements, allowing them to structure their practice using appointments, walk-ins, or telehealth consults based on personal preference. The centre supports professional development through access to accredited CPD webinars and training opportunities. To accommodate varied professional needs, short-term agreements and no exclusivity requirement options are available. This is an ideal role for a VR GP who desires a supportive clinical team, high flexibility, and an unbeatable Sydney Eastern suburbs coastal lifestyle. The convenience of designated GP car parking is also provided.   Apply Now
